first.rationale: Verify the onboarding-shortening result because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making it highly consequential to sustainable qualified revenue. Also verify the promotional-pricing evidence because competitor pricing creates a credible alternative, but discounts may acquire lower-quality revenue and reduce long-term value. Pending verification, run a small guarded onboarding simplification test with activation, completion, qualified pipeline, retention proxies, and revenue quality as guardrails.

final.rationale: Run a standard, controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified evidence shows shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines. Signup simplification and in-product activation messaging provide supporting evidence. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue initially, the verified cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Track activation, onboarding completion, time-to-value, qualified revenue, renewal-quality proxies, and retention guardrails before scaling.
